question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"rhyme."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **"Rhyme"** is a literary device where words have similar sounds at the end of their syllables. (तुक, अंत्‍यानुप्रास (शब्‍दगत ध्वनियों की समानता), क़ाफ़िया)
 
• It is often used in poetry to create a rhythmic and memorable effect.
